target_customer: Hotels, starting with Hilton, Marriott and IHG branded properties, for housekeeping and laundry work
problem: Housekeeping teams repeatedly move linens between floors, restock carts and fold stacks of laundry every shift, which is physical and hard to staff.
business_model: Robot pilots with hotels, pricing not published

founders.name: Daniel
founders.background_notes: Named in the company description only, surname and profile not available.

founders.background_notes: Named in the company description only, surname and profile not available.

competitors.name: Dyna Robotics
competitors.what: Embodied AI humanoid for laundry and towel folding, deployed in hotels and laundromats
competitors.traction_then: Deployments in hotels, gyms and laundromats mentioned by press

competitors.name: Lindstrom towel folding robot
competitors.what: Industrial towel folding robot at a hotel textile service center

competitors.name: Sewts VELUM
competitors.what: AI vision and robot arm feeding towels into industrial folders
competitors.traction_then: 500 to 600 textiles per hour at a German laundry

technical_complexity.rationale: Learned manipulation of cloth from a few hundred demonstrations plus a mobile base that rides elevators is hard robotics; towel folding in 23.8 seconds is self-reported.

defensibility.rationale: Well funded humanoid and manipulation companies target the same task, and demos alone are not a durable moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Funded robotics firms already sold or piloted laundry folding in 2025. Later outcome unknown.

market_need_then: Hotels face housekeeping labor shortages, and industrial laundries in Europe and Korea adopted towel automation in 2025 and 2026 for that reason per trade coverage.

identity.logo: Text name only, no logo description
identity.voice_and_tone: Short declarative fragments such as Carries. Delivers. Folds., and candid, labeling the hero film as a render

branding.brand_signature: The film is a render. This isn't.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand; many unrelated companies use Vibe in their names.

outcome_analysis: Vibe Robotics is a Winter 2027 team of four with ex-NVIDIA and Tesla founders piloting a towel folding robot at a Hilton property, per its YC page. It faces well funded laundry robot rivals and has no verified funding, so the outcome is unknown and depends on turning demos into paid hotel deployments.
notes: A PitchBook profile for a Vibe Robotics in Austin, TX (founded 2025, investors Purdue Innovates, Root Ventures, Schematic Ventures) appeared in search, and an F4 Fund page describes a multimodal robot interface. These do not match the YC company's San Francisco hotel robot, so they are not recorded as rounds and may be a different company. Hilton pilot is company stated only. Founder education not found.
